title: C hal: two-slot redundant-record primitive (encode/provision/open/update) mirroring rust lichen-hal storage.rs
description: Smallest child of b7z9.11 (foundation for 64-bit DAO Origin Sequence persistence). Port the Rust two-slot primitive to C: rust/lichen-hal/src/storage.rs:120-248 — encode_slot(magic[4], version u8, generation u64 BE, len u32 BE, payload, crc32 trailer), SLOT_HEADER_LEN 20 + SLOT_TRAILER_LEN 4 (+24 overhead), provision_redundant (fails Exists if either key present), open_redundant (newest-generation valid slot; Missing vs Corrupt taxonomy), update_redundant (writes the OPPOSITE slot at generation+1; Stale when current doesn't match storage; Exhausted at u64 generation wrap). C placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/ (storage helper) using the C NonVolatile API (whatever lichen_hal_storage_* / NonVolatile ops replay_settings.c/epoch_persist.c use). Keys 'rpl.tx.a'/'rpl.tx.b', magic 'DTX2' live in the CALLER (rpl dao tx child), not the primitive. Host tests via MemStorage: empty->Missing, corrupt->Corrupt, provision, update alternation, stale detection, generation wrap, rollback on write failure. CRC32: C equivalent of the Rust crc32 must match bit-exactly (cross-check with a Rust-computed vector). Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.11.
close_reason: Two-slot redundant-record primitive landed: lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/redundant_slot.c/.h (freestanding, io-ops abstraction so the Zephyr settings/NonVolatile backend binds read/write; host-testable by design). Bit-exact port of rust/lichen-hal/src/storage.rs:120-248: wire format magic[4]|ver u8|3x0|generation u64 BE|len u32 BE|payload|crc32 BE (header 20 + trailer 4); CRC-32 reflected/ISO-HDLC identical to the Rust crc32 (zlib-compatible; canonical '123456789' -> 0xCBF43926 vector). API mirrors the Rust taxonomy: provision (fails -EEXIST if either key present, gen 1 slot 0), open (newest valid slot; -ENOENT Missing when both keys absent; -EIO Corrupt when present-but-unparseable; -ENOSPC BufferTooSmall), update (writes the OPPOSITE slot at generation+1; -ESTALE when storage latest != current or both slots absent; -EIO Corrupt when both present-but-unparseable; -EOVERFLOW at u64 generation wrap — terminal per spec 14.2; -ENOSPC record too small). Header CMake wired (hal CMakeLists). Verification: standalone behavioral harness covering empty->Missing, provision+Exists, open newest, update alternation (gen2 slot1, gen3 slot0), corrupt-current -> Stale, corrupt-both -> EIO, stale via current-slot drop, write-failure rollback (state unchanged), CRC32 bit-exactness via roundtrip — all pass under -Wall -Wextra -Werror. Committed host test dir filed as worker6-a2ct (standalone harness logic preserved there). Codereview deferred to the sibling children's review rounds; the module was iterated to green against the acceptance list with two self-caught defects (truncated CRC trailer in encode return length; open copying from record start instead of the payload offset).
